description: This file defines the 'Order' model class for the checkout process in the OpenCart e-commerce system. It includes methods for creating, updating, deleting, and retrieving order data, along with managing associated products, totals, options, subscriptions, and order histories.

classes.name: Order
classes.description: Model class managing orders, their products, options, totals, subscriptions, and histories in the OpenCart checkout system.

methods.name: addOrder
methods.description: Creates a new order record in the database, including related products and totals.

methods.name: editOrder
methods.description: Updates an existing order record, handling statuses, products, options, and financial data.

methods.name: editTransactionId
methods.description: Updates the transaction ID associated with an order.

methods.name: editOrderStatusId
methods.description: Updates the status ID of an order.

methods.name: editComment
methods.description: Updates the comment associated with an order.

methods.name: deleteOrder
methods.description: Deletes an order and its related data, including products, totals, histories, transactions, and rewards.

methods.name: getOrder
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information about an order, including products, totals, and associated country/zone info.

methods.name: addProduct
methods.description: Adds a product to an order, including options and subscriptions.

methods.name: deleteProducts
methods.description: Removes all products from an order and related options and subscriptions.

methods.name: getProduct
methods.description: Retrieves a specific product in an order.

methods.name: getProducts
methods.description: Retrieves all products for an order.

methods.name: addOption
methods.description: Adds an option to a product in an order.

methods.name: deleteOptions
methods.description: Deletes all options of a specific order.

methods.name: getOptions
methods.description: Retrieves options for a specific product in an order.

methods.name: addSubscription
methods.description: Creates a subscription record linked to a product in an order.

methods.name: deleteSubscription
methods.description: Removes subscription records for an order.

methods.name: getSubscription
methods.description: Retrieves a specific subscription for a product in an order.

methods.name: getSubscriptions
methods.description: Retrieves all subscriptions associated with an order.

methods.name: getTotalOrdersBySubscriptionId
methods.description: Counts total orders associated with a particular subscription ID.

methods.name: addTotal
methods.description: Adds a total record to an order.

methods.name: deleteTotals
methods.description: Removes all total records for an order.

methods.name: getTotals
methods.description: Retrieves total records for an order.

methods.name: addHistory
methods.description: Adds a status change entry to the order history, handling various order state changes and related effects.

methods.name: deleteHistories
methods.description: Removes all history entries for an order.
